links.outcome: Readability grade level of ChatGPT-generated ostomy patient education material
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 8.53, Gunning Fog 10.9, SMOG 7.99; authors concluded the material is at a high reading level for patients, despite PEMAT understandability 81.91% and actionability 85.33%.
links.quote: The AI-assisted patient education material for ostomy patients provided accurate information with understandable and actionable responses to patients, but is at a high reading level for patients.

screen.reason: Empirical study developing and evaluating ChatGPT-generated patient education materials for ostomy patients using readability metrics and expert panel assessment (PEMAT), but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice comparison.
